title: PACCAR Incorporated: Insufficient Lubricant in Front Steer Drive Axle (29 affected)
summary: PACCAR Incorporated (PACCAR) is recalling certain 2024 Peterbilt 537, 2024-2025 Kenworth T380, T480, Peterbilt 548, and 2025 Peterbilt 536 trucks, equipped with certain Meritor 10-16K and 18-23K front steer drive axles.  The front steer drive axles may have insufficient wheel bearing lubricant.

title: Tesla, Inc.: Headlights May Flicker/FMVSS 108 (25 affected)
summary: Tesla, Inc. (Tesla) is recalling certain 2024 Model X vehicles.  The parking lights and low beam headlights may flicker.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: Pierce Manufacturing: Incompatible Tires and Wheels/FMVSS 120 (8 affected)
summary: Pierce Manufacturing (Pierce) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Enforcer, Quantum, and Velocity fire trucks.  The tires mounted on the front steer axles are incompatible with the wheels.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 120, "Wheels and Rims - Other Than Passenger Cars."

title: International Motors, LLC: Inoperative Defrosting System/FMVSS 103 (22 affected)
summary: International Motors, LLC (International) is recalling certain 2025 EMV vehicles.  A circuit breaker may be missing, causing the defrosting system to be inoperative.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 103, "Windshield Defrosting and Defogging Systems."

title: Nova Bus (US) Inc.: Incorrectly Installed Wheelchair Securement System (24 affected)
summary: Nova Bus (US) Inc. (Nova Bus) is recalling certain 2022-2024 LFS buses.  The wheelchair securement system may have been installed with the attachment points in the incorrect locations.

title: PACCAR Incorporated: Loss of Steering Control (68 affected)
summary: PACCAR Incorporated (PACCAR) is recalling certain 2024 Peterbilt 367, 389, 548, Kenworth T480, T800, 2024-2025 Peterbilt 520, 567 and Kenworth T880 vehicles with PACCAR 20k steer axles.  The steering arm and/or tie rod bracket fasteners may fail, resulting in a loss of steering control.

title: Prestone Products LLC: Brake Fluid Bottles Contain Power Steering Fluid (320 affected)
summary: Prestone Products LLC (Prestone) is recalling certain 1-gallon bottles of Prestone DOT 3 Brake Fluid, part number AS402 with date code 2PW24226 manufactured on August 13, 2024.  The brake fluid bottles may contain power steering fluid.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: Roof Frame Crack May Damage Air Bag on Deployment (130 affected)
summary: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain 2025 X4 xDrive 30i, X4 M40i and X4 M vehicles.  The inner-left roof frame near the head air bag may have a crack that can damage the head air bag during deployment.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: Loss of Control From Cracked Wheel Swivel Bearing (2 affected)
summary: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain 2025 X3 30 vehicles.  The front wheel left-side swivel bearing may crack, causing a loss of vehicle handling and control.

title: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing: Loose Bolts on Brake Caliper and Wheel Hub Bearing (70 affected)
summary: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain 2024 RAV4 and 2025 Lexus NX vehicles.  Some of the bolts that secure the front brake caliper and the wheel hub bearing may be loose, which can result in a damaged caliper brake hose or possible wheel detachment.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Inadequately Reflective Turn Signal/FMVSS 108 (6,963 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2009-2017 Georgetown Class A motorhomes.  The amber turn signal lens has an undersized reflective surface.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: Forest River, Inc.: Propane Tank May Detach From Vehicle (864 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc (Forest River) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Clipper and Viking travel trailers.  Please see the recall report for a complete list of models.  The bottle bracket welds may break and cause the propane tank to detach from the vehicle.

title: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC: Raised Air Intake May Detach (485 affected)
summary: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC (Land Rover) is recalling certain 2020-2025 Land Rover Defender vehicles equipped with Raised Air Intake (RAI) aftermarket accessory equipment, with part number VPLEP0543.  The raised air intake may not be secured properly, which can allow the intake to detach from the vehicle.

title: McNeilus Truck & Manufacturing, Inc.: CNG Manual Cylinder Valve May Crack And Leak (15 affected)
summary: McNeilus Truck & Manufacturing, Inc. (McNeilus) is recalling certain 2024 Atlantic and Zero Radius Side Loader vehicles equipped with certain Agility Fuel Solutions CNG Fuel Systems, using part number 10300466.  The manual cylinder valves may develop stress corrosion cracks in the bottom plugged port, causing a leak.

title: Autocar, LLC: Speed Governor Limit Can Be Circumvented/FMVSS 136 (104 affected)
summary: Autocar, LLC (Autocar) is recalling certain 2023-2025 ACTT (Xspotter) vehicles.  A software error may allow the vehicle to exceed the speed governor limit.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 136, "Electronic Stability Control Systems on Heavy Vehicles."

title: Prinx Chengshan Tire North America, Inc.: Insufficient Traction for Snow Tires/FMVSS 139 (541,632 affected)
summary: Prinx Chengshan Tire North America, Inc. (PCTNA) is recalling certain Fortune Tormenta and Prinx Hicountry sold as replacements tires.  Please refer to the 573 Safety Report for specific sizes.  The tires are labeled as snow tires, but do not have sufficient traction to perform in all snow weather conditions.  As such, these tires fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 139, "New Pneumatic Radial Tires for Light Vehicles."

title: Meritor, Inc.: Insufficient Lubricant in Front Steer Axle Hub (128 affected)
summary: Meritor, Inc. (Meritor) is recalling certain 10-16K and 18-23K front steer drive axles, part numbers FSD 8-16K and FSD 18.  An insufficient amount of lubricant in the front steer drive (FSD) axle hubs may result in damage to the wheel bearings.

title: Kia America, Inc.: Fuel Line May Become Damaged During Crash (1,385 affected)
summary: Kia America, Inc. (Kia) is recalling certain 2025 Sorento Plug-In Hybrid vehicles.  During a crash, the steering rack may damage the fuel line, which can result in a fuel leak.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Reduced Visibility of Reverse Lights/FMVSS 108 (2,135 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2021-2023 Jeep Renegade vehicles.  The incorrect bumper reverse light assembly may have been installed.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: Grand Design RV, LLC: Interior Step Tread May Detach From Base (508 affected)
summary: Grand Design RV, LLC (Grand Design) is recalling certain 2023-2025 Momentum fifth wheel trailers.  The interior step base does not adequately support the step tread.

title: Oshkosh Corporation: Throttle Pedal Assembly May Stick (800 affected)
summary: Oshkosh Corporation (Oshkosh) is recalling certain 2022-2024 S-Series vehicles.  The throttle pedal assembly may contain an oversized magnet carrier, slowing the responsiveness or causing the pedal to stick.

title: Roadtrek Inc.: Restricted Seat Belt Movement/FMVSS 207, 209 (60 affected)
summary: Roadtrek Inc. (Roadtrek) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Westfalia Wave motorhomes.  The seat belt guide bracket may be missing from the second-row seats.  The seat belts' movement may be restricted without the bracket.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) numbers 207, "Seating Systems" and 209, "Seat Belt Assemblies."

title: PACCAR Incorporated: Loss of ABS and Electronic Stability Control (220,764 affected)
summary: PACCAR Incorporated (PACCAR) is recalling certain 2021-2025 Peterbilt and Kenworth vehicles, equipped with Bendix EC80 Advanced Electronic Control Units (ECU).  Please see the recall report for a complete list of models.  Electrical noise and low signal to the power line carrier may cause the ECU to incorrectly process commands or stop functioning.

title: Great Dane Trailers: Missing Kingpin Welds May Allow Trailer Separation (225 affected)
summary: Great Dane Trailers (Great Dane) is recalling certain 2025 Champion Dry Freight trailers.  Missing kingpin welds may prevent the upper coupler from securely connecting the trailer.

title: Gillig, LLC: Odometer Malfunction in EV Mode/FMVSS 101 (9 affected)
summary: Gillig, LLC (Gillig) is recalling certain 2023 Low Floor diesel-hybrid transit buses.  During vehicle operations in full electric vehicle (EV) mode, the odometer will not display accumulated mileage.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 101, "Controls and Displays."

title: Advanced Technology Products, Inc: Air Brake Tubing May Burst/FMVSS 106 (235 affected)
summary: Advanced Technology Products, Inc (ATP) is recalling certain OEC/Technidot black 1/4" DOT air brake tubing with part numbers DOTA04ABK, DOTA04CBK, and DOTA04DBK.  Sunlight exposure may cause the air brake tubing to crack and burst under pressure.  As such, this equipment fails to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 106, "Brake Hoses."

title: Suzuki Motor USA, LLC: Fuel Supply Hose May Leak Fuel (556 affected)
summary: Suzuki Motor USA, LLC (Suzuki) is recalling certain 2023-2025 Burgman 400 (AN400AM3-M5) scooters.  The fuel supply hose assembly may contact the fuel vapor hose assembly, causing the fuel supply hose to become damaged and leak fuel.

title: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC: Unexpected Engine Shutdown (139 affected)
summary: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain 2015-2020 Freightliner Business Class M2 emergency vehicles equipped with certain Cummins diesel engines.  The engine protection and inducement software may cause the engine to shut down unexpectedly.

title: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC: High-Voltage Battery May Overheat (85 affected)
summary: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC (Jaguar) is recalling certain 2019 Jaguar I-PACE vehicles that received an improper interim repair under recall number 24V-633.  The high-voltage battery may overheat.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Improper Air Bag Deployment/FMVSS 208,301 (631 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2024 Jeep Grand Cherokee and Grand Cherokee L vehicles.  The radiator crossmember bolts may not be properly secured, which can lead to improper air bag deployments and a fuel leak during a crash.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) numbers 208, "Occupant Crash Protection" and 301, "Fuel System Integrity."

title: General Motors, LLC: Insufficient Pedestrian Warning Sound/FMVSS 141 (7,606 affected)
summary: General Motors LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2025 Chevrolet Equinox EV vehicles.  The pedestrian alert sound system may have incorrect software and not produce sound at a sufficient volume.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 141, "Minimum Sound Requirements for Hybrid and Electric Vehicles."

title: Oshkosh Corporation: Rearview Camera Image May Not Display/FMVSS 111 (144 affected)
summary: Oshkosh Corporation (Oshkosh) is recalling certain 2025 Defense NGDV ICE vehicles.  The rearview camera image may not display when the vehicle is placed in reverse.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 111, "Rear Visibility."

title: Featherlite Trailer Manufacturing, LLC: Cooktop Gas Line May Overheat and Start a Fire (30 affected)
summary: Featherlite Trailer Manufacturing, LLC (Featherlite) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Living Quarters Horse Trailers, models 7821, 7841, 9807, and 9808.  The cooktop may have a rubber gas line instead of a copper line.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Propane Tanks May Detach (116 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2025 RPOD RPT197 and RPT205 travel trailers.  The propane tank tray may be missing the required number of fasteners, allowing the tanks to detach.

title: Daimler Vans USA, LLC: Instrument Cluster Display Too Bright/FMVSS 101 (697 affected)
summary: Daimler Vans USA, LLC (DVUSA) is recalling certain 2019-2022 Mercedes-Benz Sprinter vehicles.  The instrument cluster illumination may not be adjustable and appear too bright in certain lighting conditions.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 101, "Controls and Displays."

title: Mitsubishi Fuso Truck of America, Inc.: Electric Motors May Unexpectedly Shut Down (243 affected)
summary: Mitsubishi Fuso Truck of America, Inc. (MFTA) is recalling certain 2024 FEC7K and FEC9K RIZON trucks.  Excessive current may damage the circuit and cause the vehicle control unit to malfunction, resulting in a loss of drive power.

title: Cummins, Inc.: Incorrect Part in Coolant System May Cause Leak (203 affected)
summary: Cummins, Inc. (Cummins) is recalling certain B6.7 Diesel Engines part numbers RA11741 and RA11769, and F3.8 Diesel Engines part numbers RA 11789 and RA00074.  The incorrect rubber elbow was installed in the liquid cooling system.  The elbow can expand and leak coolant.

title: Cummins, Inc.: Unsecured Wire Leads May Chafe And Short (205 affected)
summary: Cummins, Inc. (Cummins) is recalling certain 2022-2024 Power Generation C275D2RE trailer-mounted generators. The unsecured wire leads may chafe against the starter motor housing or terminal and short circuit.

title: VinFast Auto, LLC: Center Air Bag May Deploy Improperly (4,888 affected)
summary: VinFast Auto, LLC (VinFast) is recalling certain 2023-2025 VF8 vehicles.  The center air bag mounted in the driver's seat may deploy improperly during a side impact crash and strike the driver's arm.

title: Dicor Corporation: Cooktop Burner Tube May Crack and Cause Gas Leak (876 affected)
summary: Dicor Corporation (Dicor) is recalling certain InVision Three Burner Cooktops, model number 410-2030.  The aluminum burner tube may crack and cause a gas leak.

title: Tesla, Inc.: TPMS Light May Not Remain Illuminated/FMVSS 138 (696,281 affected)
summary: Tesla, Inc. (Tesla) is recalling certain 2024 Cybertruck, 2017-2025 Model 3, and 2020-2025 Model Y vehicles.  The tire pressure monitoring system (TPMS) warning light may not remain illuminated between drive cycles, failing to warn the driver of low tire pressure.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 138, "Tire Pressure Monitoring Systems."

title: General Motors, LLC: Insufficient Pedestrian Warning Sound/FMVSS 141 (46 affected)
summary: General Motors LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2025 Chevrolet Silverado EV work trucks.  The pedestrian alert sound system may not produce sound at a sufficient volume.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 141, "Minimum Sound Requirements for Hybrid and Electric Vehicles."

title: Volvo Car USA, LLC: Driver's Side Inner Air Bag May Deploy Improperly (2 affected)
summary: Volvo Car USA, LLC (Volvo Car) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Volvo C40 vehicles.  The clamps may be improperly crimped on the driver's side inner far side air bag module (FSAB), which can cause the air bag to deploy improperly.

title: Polestar Automotive USA, Inc.: Driver's Side Inner Air Bag May Deploy Improperly (7 affected)
summary: Polestar Automotive USA, Inc. (Polestar) is recalling certain 2024 Polestar 2 electric vehicles.  The clamps may be improperly crimped on the driver's side inner far side air bag module (FSAB), which can cause the air bag to deploy improperly.

title: Polestar Automotive USA, Inc.: Unexpected Loss of Drive Power (6 affected)
summary: Polestar Automotive USA, Inc. (Polestar) is recalling certain 2025 Polestar 3 hybrid electric vehicles.  Fluctuations in the 12-volt system may have damaged the High to Low Voltage Converter Module (HLCM).

title: DiamondBack Automotive Accessories, Inc.: Truck Bed Cover May Detach (1,472 affected)
summary: DiamondBack Automotive Accessories, Inc (DiamondBack) is recalling certain Switchback truck bed covers designed for 2015-2024 Ford F-150, 2017-2024 Ford Super Duty F-250 F-350, and F-450 vehicles as an aftermarket accessory.  The cap clamps included with the cover may loosen over time, allowing the cover to detach during transit.

title: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC: Rear Axle Carrier May Fail (17 affected)
summary: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC (MBUSA) is recalling certain 2025 E 350, E 350 4MATIC, E 450 4MATIC, and E450 4MATIC station wagon vehicles.  The camber strut bracket may have been improperly welded onto the rear axle carrier, possibly resulting in separation of the bracket from the rear axle carrier.

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): Fuel Tank and Filler Neck Improperly Welded (167 affected)
summary: Acura (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2021-2023 TLX vehicles.  The fuel filler neck and fuel tank may have been improperly welded, which can result in a fuel leak.

title: Ford Motor Company: Loss of Steering from Front Control Arm Separation (11,922 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2023-2024 F-150 Lightning BEV vehicles.  The front upper control arm ball joint nut may not have been tightened properly, allowing the front upper control arm to detach from the knuckle assembly.

title: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC: Rearview Camera Image May Not Display (11,961 affected)
summary: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC (Land Rover) is recalling certain 2022-2023 Range Rover vehicles.  Water may enter into the rearview camera, which can cause the rearview camera image not to appear on the display or display a distorted image.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Rearview Camera Image May Not Display/FMVSS 111 (79,365 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2024 Jeep Wagoneer, Grand Wagoneer, Grand Cherokee, and Grand Cherokee L vehicles.  Incorrect software in the rearview camera module may cause the rearview camera image not to display.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 111, "Rear Visibility."

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Brake Pedal May Detach from Brake Booster (2,021 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2019-2020 Alfa Romeo Giulia and Alfa Romeo Stelvio vehicles.  The fastener that connects the brake pedal and the brake booster may have been improperly assembled during manufacturing, which can cause the brake pedal to detach from the brake booster.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Inoperative Headlights/FMVSS 108 (53 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2025 Ram 1500 pickup trucks.  Incorrect headlight module software may cause the headlights to become inoperative.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Brake Pedal May Detach from Brake Booster (101 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain Mopar anti-lock brake control units with part numbers 68473794AA, 68473795AA, 68505330AA, and 68472901AA.  The fastener that connects the brake pedal and the brake booster may have been improperly assembled during manufacturing, which can cause the brake pedal to detach from the brake booster.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Rearview Camera Image May Not Display/FMVSS 111 (295 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain Mopar rearview camera modules with part numbers 68598674AF, 68617886AD, and 68617887AD.  Incorrect software in the rearview camera module may cause the rearview camera image not to display.  As such, this equipment fails to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 111, "Rear Visibility."

title: Lamborghini (Automobili Lamborghini): Oil line May Leak and Cause Fire (2 affected)
summary: Lamborghini (Automobili Lamborghini) is recalling certain 2024 Revuelto vehicles.  The oil circuit connection flange screws may have been improperly tightened during assembly, which could cause the oil line to leak.

title: Orange EV: Missing Front Marker Light Reflectors/FMVSS 108 (1,276 affected)
summary: Orange EV is recalling certain 2023-2024 HUSK-e, 2023-2025 e-TRIEVER, and 2017-2024 T-Series trucks.  The front side marker lights may be missing, and the passenger front side reflectors may be in the incorrect location.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: Orange EV: Frame Extenders Obstruct Rear Lights/FMVSS 108 (148 affected)
summary: Orange EV (OEV) is recalling certain 2023-2024 HUSK-e, 2023-2025 e-TRIEVERs, and 2018-2023 T-Series trucks built with frame extenders.  The frame extenders obstruct the rear turn signals, reverse, brake, and taillights.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: Orange EV: Beavertail Frame Obstructs Reverse Lights/FMVSS108 (37 affected)
summary: Orange EV is recalling certain 2023-2024 e-TRIEVER and 2018-2023 T-Series trucks built with beavertail frames.  The end of the beavertail frame may obstruct the center of the reverse lights.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: Gillig, LLC: Damaged Fire Suppression Relay Cable May Fail (201 affected)
summary: Gillig, LLC (Gillig) is recalling certain 2021-2024 Low Floor style transit buses.  The fire suppression relay cable may be damaged, chafing against the mounting bolt, and fail.

title: Ford Motor Company: High Pressure Fuel Pump May Fail (295,449 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2020-2022 F-Super Duty F250, F350, F450, F550, F600, and 2021-2022 F-650, F750 vehicles. Biodiesel deposits may form on the pump drivetrain roller components, which could lead to failure of the high pressure fuel pump.

title: Ford Motor Company: High Voltage Battery May Short Circuit (20,484 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2020-2024 Ford Escape, and 2021-2024 Lincoln Corsair vehicles.  A manufacturing defect in one or more of the high voltage battery cells may result in an internal short circuit and battery failure.

title: Ford Motor Company: Incorrectly Installed Engine Cup Plug May Leak Oil (2,490 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2024-2025 F-150, 2024 Expedition and 2024 Lincoln Navigator vehicles equipped with a 3.5L GTDI engine.  The engines may have a misaligned engine cup plug, which can result in a rapid oil leak.

title: Ford Motor Company: Power Windows May Pinch/FMVSS 118 (47,818 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Lincoln Nautilus vehicles.  The window automatic reversal system may not react correctly after detecting an obstruction, and the window reversal distance does not meet the minimum requirement.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 118, "Power-Operated Window Systems."

title: Ford Motor Company: Rearview Camera Image May Not Display (30,715 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2019 Flex, Fiesta, and Lincoln MKT vehicles.  The rearview camera may intermittently display a blank or distorted image.

title: Altec Industries, Inc.: Front Axle Load May Fail (82 affected)
summary: Altec Industries, Inc. (Altec) is recalling certain 2017-2024 Ford E350 van chassis equipped with a AT200A devices.  The units mounted on certain Ford E350 van chassis with Gross Axle Weight Rating (GAWR) of 4050 and 4200 pounds, may fail at high loads due to a defect in the front axle.

title: Gillig, LLC: HV Air Compressor Is Not On Protective HVIL Loop (332 affected)
summary: Gillig, LLC (Gillig) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Low Floor style transit buses.  The high voltage electric air compressor may not be connected to the High Voltage Interlock Loop (HVIL).  Therefore, the HVIL cannot detect a loose or disconnected compressor power cable.

title: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC: Mounting Brackets May Damage Air Bag FMVSS/214/226 (1 affected)
summary: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC (MBUSA) is recalling a certain 2023 EQS 450+ vehicle.  The mounting brackets near the roof may have sharp edges that can damage the side-curtain air bag during deployment.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) numbers 214, "Side Impact Protection," and 226, "Ejection Mitigation."

title: Kia America, Inc.: Missing Seat Mounting Bolts (22,883 affected)
summary: Kia America, Inc. (Kia) is recalling certain 2024-2025 EV9 vehicles.  The second- and third-row seat mounting bolts may be missing.

title: Indian Motorcycle Company: Display May Show False Gear Selection/FMVSS 123 (4,926 affected)
summary: Indian Motorcycle Company (Indian) is recalling certain 2025 Scout and Scout Sixty motorcycles.  Please see the recall report for a complete list of affected trims.  The gear position display may falsely show that the motorcycle is in neutral.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 123, "Motorcycle Controls and Displays."

title: Storyteller Overland: Secondary Alternator May Short and Overheat (196 affected)
summary: Storyteller Overland, LLC (Storyteller Overland) is recalling certain 2024 Beast Mode, Classic Mode, Stealth Mode, and Mystic Mode vehicles.  An improperly torqued internal component may cause the secondary alternator to short circuit and overheat.

title: Storyteller Overland: Improperly Grounded Metal Frame (28 affected)
summary: Storyteller Overland, LLC (Storyteller Overland) is recalling certain 2023-2024 GXV HILT vehicles.  The metal frames within the housing portion of the vehicle may be improperly grounded.

title: Nissan North America, Inc.: Unexpected Vehicle Movement/FMVSS 114 (89 affected)
summary: Nissan North America, Inc. (Nissan) is recalling certain 2025 Kicks vehicles.  The "Shift-to-Park" warning may not activate as intended when the vehicle is shut off and still in a gear other than "Park."  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 114, "Theft Protection and Rollaway Prevention."

title: Horizon Global: Tow Vehicle May Separate From Hitch Receiver Lock (145,431 affected)
summary: Horizon Global (Horizon) is recalling certain Reese Hitch Receiver Locks with part numbers 7057030, 7057230, 7057033, 7054630, and 7057130.  The cap on the receiver lock may become loose and separate from the pin.

title: Tesla, Inc.: Air Bag May Tear During Deployment/FMVSS 208 (487 affected)
summary: Tesla, Inc. (Tesla) is recalling certain 2021-2025 Model S and Model X vehicles.  The driver's air bag could tear during deployment.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) numbers 208, "Occupant Crash Protection" and 212, "Windshield Mounting."

title: GEM WAEV LLC: The Wheel May Separate From The Ball Joint (243 affected)
summary: GEM WAEV LLC (GEM) is recalling certain 2024-2025 e2, e4, e6, and eLXD vehicles.  The mounting screws between the ball joint and the hub strut may have been improperly tightened, resulting in ball joint separation from the wheel.

title: Winnebago Industries, Inc.: Entrance Door Window May Detach (5,313 affected)
summary: Winnebago Industries, Inc. (Winnebago) is recalling certain 2020-2024 Winnebago View and Navion recreational vehicles equipped with certain Lippert Metallarte door assemblies.  The door assembly may have been manufactured with incorrect window adhesion, causing the window to loosen or detached.
